title: UI风格#113 - Nordic Midsummer (北欧仲夏)
description: 创建第113种UI风格：北欧仲夏风格 - 极昼、金色阳光、野花、瑞典国旗色。输出到 G:/claude_code_project/web/index_planDI.html

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Nordic Midsummer style When color palette Then features sunshine yellow, cloud white, sky blue, grass green, strawberry red
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 需要设计：#FFD700 (阳光金), #FFFFFF (云白), #87CEEB (天空蓝), #228B22 (草地绿), #FF6B6B (草莓红)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Nordic Midsummer style When typography Then uses folk fonts: Almendra, Josefin Sans, or Nothing You Could Do
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 字体选择：Almendra (标题), Josefin Sans (正文), Nothing You Could Do (装饰)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Nordic Midsummer style When layout Then flower crowns, midsummer pole, lake reflections, birch trees
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 布局特点：花冠、仲夏柱、湖面倒影、白桦树、野花甸

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Nordic Midsummer style When UI elements Then flower animations, sunlight rays, maypole dancing
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 交互特点：花朵动画、阳光射线、五朔节柱舞、蝴蝶飘飞

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Nordic Midsummer UI When functional Then includes folk chat, midsummer agents, flower stats
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 功能需求：民俗聊天、仲夏代理、花卉统计

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Nordic Midsummer UI When copy Then uses scandinavian: 'Midsommar', 'Solstice', 'Flora', 'Folk'
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 创意文案：标题'MIDSOMMAR. SOLSTICE. FLORA.'、按钮'SEND'→'DANCE'、'SUBMIT'→'CELEBRATE'
